column1: # A second reading of the parallel passages: seven passages from letters A to D (see the top of
# data/groups.tsv), set as 29 numbered points. Each point names a word of the deciphered text, and the reader
# was asked which tokens of the cipher stand for it. The points were chosen in this study. The reader had
# enlarged strips of the passages and their deciphered text, and neither the key nor the paragraph of 1520.
# For A and C the deciphered text was this study's transcription of the decipherment of 1521, and for B and D
# Danvila's print. docs/METHOD.md gives the instructions, and the question at point 22 asked the reader to
# compare the tokens with the same tokens at other points. The answers are written in the notation used here,
# with the reader's z for the 2-shaped r written r; a letter sign is written + and its letter. A point that
# concerns more than one place has a row for each.
# letter, image, line: the place, with lines counted as docs/METHOD.md says. The crops in
#   images/parallels/ are named by letter, image and lines.
# kind: key = the tokens are groups of the key, perhaps with letter signs, and the check spells them with
#   the key's values; q = the sign for q, described by its shape; other = see the note.
